description.text: The lane runs south between a cooper's yard and a low cottage, both dark, and gives out at a field gate. One window has a candle in it — the chandler's, of course.

A working lane, narrow and rutted: a cooper's yard on the right stacked with staves and half-hooped barrels, a chandler's cottage on the left with trays of tapers set out to harden in the cool. South, the lane opens into the fields.
A narrow lane running south to the fields, with a cooper's yard on one side and the chandler's cottage on the other. Barrels, wax, and the smell of both.
